title: Windows file dialogs start from Documents via the process working folder; export dialog owned by the app window
context: Review of ec32fe2c: forcing initialDirectory=Documents calls IFileDialog::SetFolder on every export, which overrides the per-app last folder Windows remembers (Microsoft advises against SetFolder before Show); a Documents lookup error would also fail the export. Lab evidence: with no folder set, the dialog opened the process working folder (System32 when launched from cmd, the install folder from the Start-menu shortcut).
options: Persist the last export folder in a new settings key and pass it, falling back to Documents
Set the process working folder to Documents in the runner after window creation and pass no folder
outcome: Runner sets the working folder to FOLDERID_Documents after window.Create (99b40058); export passes only the owner handle. First dialog opens Documents, later ones reopen the last folder as Windows remembers it, matching macOS NSSavePanel behaviour, and the photo Open dialog's first folder is fixed too. Cost: a process-wide working-folder change; nothing in the app resolves paths against it (Flutter assets resolve against the exe folder, and the app ran with System32 as its working folder in the lab).
